# wg-comments

The working-group review record: internal authoring and Technical Working Group comments, one public-comment/1.0.0 file per comment (comments/PC-NNNN.json), one changeset/1.0.0 per change set (changesets/CS-NNN.json), one manifest per intake batch (batches/), and config.json naming the editors and committee. Same machinery as the smart-ra public review, at working-group scale; a public review, when there is one, gets its own store at review/public-comment/.

Part of [Digital Transformation Handbook: Planning for Human Resources for Health and Health Worker Registries](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `wg-comments`, holding `todo-items`, `public-comments`.

| file | what it is | used by |
|---|---|---|
| [`config.json`](config.json) | DTH-HRH working document (internal working-group review) |  |
| [`batches/`](batches/) | _nothing declares what this holds_ | |
| [`changesets/`](changesets/) | _nothing declares what this holds_ | |
| [`comments/`](comments/) | _nothing declares what this holds_ | |
